title: cmdsync config
description: Config for cmdsync, in cmdsync.json or the "cmdsync" key of package.json

comment.description: Comment delimiters: ["#"] for line comments, ["/*", "*/"] for block comments

marker.description: Starts a directive: <!-- MARKER start: command -->

endMarker.description: End of a region: <!-- END_MARKER --> (default: marker + " end")

shell.description: Shell binary used to run each command (invoked as `<shell> -c <command>`)

commands.description: Command binaries directives may run. Every command in a pipeline/list must be listed. Empty allows anything.

install.description: How to install a binary that directives run, keyed by binary name. Runs (with `shell`, `cwd` and `env`) the first time a directive needs a binary that isn't on PATH.

include.description: Globs (relative to the config's directory) of files to scan

exclude.description: Globs (relative to the config's directory) to skip

syntax.description: Comment syntax per glob, checked before the built-in table. The first matching rule wins.

include.description: Globs (relative to the config's directory) this rule applies to

fences.description: Treat as markdown: skip fenced/inline code, allow the fenced code block form

comment.description: Comment delimiters for every file, overriding `syntax` and the built-in table

cwd.description: Working directory for commands, relative to the config's directory

env.description: Extra environment variables passed to every command

postUpdate.description: Commands run in order after an update wrote at least one file. Same shell, cwd and env as directives, plus CMDSYNC_CHANGED_FILES (written files, one per line, relative to the config root).

directives.description: Custom directives by name, used like a mode: <!-- CMDSYNC name: command -->. The command runs, then formatter and/or template turn its output into what's written.

mode.description: The built-in mode that writes the result

command.description: The command to run, with {cmd} for what the directive says (default: {cmd})

format.description: Default format=, applied before formatter and template

template.description: Text written, with placeholders ({output}, {cmd}, {command}, {lang}, {file}, {line}, {date}, {env.NAME}, {params.NAME}, ...) and filters ({output|trim|quote}, {output|code:txt}, ...)

formatter.description: JS/TS module, relative to the config root, whose default export (ctx: FormatterContext) => string returns what's written
